lane: Mobile + content: Nilaza reading v1 five-layer library (value report batch B, Owner approved 21/11)
goal: Finish value report batch B: every card has topic-specific reversed meanings, the Decision and Open topics get their own small steps and journal questions, and the Vietnamese reading no longer shows English card or suit names.
successCriteria: reversedTopics in packages/content/data/tarot-reading-layers.json covers all 78 canonical cards for love, career and self, in Vietnamese and English, each naming a likely inner pattern softly and one concrete action.
steps and journal cover the decision and open topics for all five energies; decision and open readings use them instead of borrowing the self set.

Vietnamese combination sentences use the approved Vietnamese names (Ẩn chính, Gậy, Cốc, Kiếm, Tiền) and the Vietnamese reading replaces an English card name inside card intros with the approved Vietnamese name.
validate:data requires all 78 cards × 3 topics and the five step topics; no forbidden certainty, healing or mind-reading wording.
Readings saved before this change still display as before.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts, model routes, quotas and migrations are unchanged.
tarot-cards.json and tarot-card-guide.json are read, not edited (rewriting the 78 card texts stays Lô A part 2).
Admin, guest flow, paywall, Nil and lock rules are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot result screen after a free draw (server draw without AI, or local fallback when the AI fails).

impact.observability: No new events; the existing feedback report still lists the summary and sections.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; saved readings keep the text they were created with.

packages/content/data/tarot-card-guide.json stays the upright per-topic meaning source
apps/mobile/src/features/tarot/localReading.ts is the only composer of the free reading text
